name: video-method-lab
description: Automatically summarize a video with evidence, screenshots and a neutral method diagram, then offer a deeper agent-assisted HTML playbook.

interface.longDescription: Paste a video link to receive its summary, observed methods, key frames and a neutral diagram. Go deeper on request to get an HTML playbook with consolidated evidence. External research is optional.
interface.defaultPrompt: Analyze this video and show its methods, key frames and a neutral diagram before offering to go deeper.
